location: Broadmeadow, Newcastle, Hunter Region, NSW, Australia

broadmeadow_main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). One of Australia's premier, widest, and fairest provincial championship tracks. The main Broadmeadow oval is 26 metres wide with a spacious 415m home straight. The layout provides an unhindered contest for all running styles, giving closing swoopers ('S') every opportunity on Good ground.
broadmeadow_main_turf.post_bias: Extremely fair course across all starting distances. The 1200m, 1400m, and 1600m chute starts provide long straight runs before cornering, ensuring wide barriers are easily overcome by patient rides.

beaumont_inner_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). The inner Beaumont circuit featuring tighter turns and a 300m home straight. Early speed ('E') and pocket pressers ('P') hold a distinct advantage here.
beaumont_inner_turf.post_bias: Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) are advantageous on the inner Beaumont track configuration.

handicapping_angles.sydney_metro_and_hunter_class_bridge: Newcastle is a primary training hub and metropolitan alternate. High-volume Sydney yards (Chris Waller, Waterhouse & Bott, James Cummings, Snowdens) and top local stables (Kris Lees, Nathan Doyle, Paul Perry) dominate. Newcastle maiden and BM78 form translates directly to Randwick and Rosehill Saturday metro grade (+3.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.broadmeadow_415m_straight_fairness: On the main Broadmeadow track, do not penalize back-markers purely for wide draws. The 415m straight and 26m width allow well-balanced gallopers with strong late sectionals to reel in leaders.
handicapping_angles.newcastle_cup_and_spring_stakes_carnival: During the September Newcastle Cup ($300k+ Group 3), Cameron Handicap ($250k+ G3), and Tibbie Stakes feature meeting, race quality elevates to Group/Listed grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for feature races.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2 (NSW Premier Provincial HQ / Newcastle Cup)
